map.由每转脉冲数求最小角度分辨率: Find the minimum angular resolution from the pulses per revolution
map.输入每转脉冲数 CPR（四倍频后），求最小角度分辨率。: Enter the pulses per revolution CPR, after quadrature decoding, to get the minimum angular resolution.
map.📖 查看「由每转脉冲数求最小角度分辨率 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the minimum angular resolution from the pulses per revolution"
map.四倍频后分辨率 = 360°/(4·CPR)。: After quadrature decoding the resolution is 360°/(4·CPR).
map.A/B 两相正交各边沿计数，共 4 倍频。: The two quadrature channels A and B are counted on every edge, giving four times the resolution.
map.与步距角区别？: How does it differ from the step angle?
map.编码器是反馈分辨率，步进是开环步距，二者不同。: The encoder gives the feedback resolution while stepping gives the open-loop step angle; the two are different things.
map.⚠ 每转脉冲 PPR 必须为正整数（≥1），不能为 0、负数或小数。: ⚠ Pulses per revolution (PPR) must be a positive integer (>= 1); 0, negative values and fractions are not allowed.
map.θ=360/(4×PPR)=360/4000=0.09°；正交 4 倍频后每转: θ = 360/(4 x PPR) = 360/4000 = 0.09°; quadrature decoding gives 4000 counts per revolution.
map.θ=360/16000=0.0225°，分辨率随 PPR 升高。: θ = 360/16000 = 0.0225°, and the resolution improves as PPR rises.
map.输入每转单相脉冲数 PPR（正交四倍频后计数为 4×PPR），求最小角度分辨率。: Enter pulses per revolution (PPR); quadrature decoding gives 4×PPR counts per rev, and the tool returns the minimum resolvable angle.
map.编码器角分辨率（四倍频口径）：Δθ = 360° ÷ (4 × PPR)；联动卡: Encoder angular resolution (quadrature): Δθ = 360° ÷ (4 × PPR); linked cards: counts per rev = 4 × PPR and resolution in arcminutes = Δθ × 60′. Validation: PPR is a required guard (no denominator table entry); PPR=0 makes 4×PPR=0 and falls back to “—”. Criterion: no fixed grading; higher PPR gives finer resolution, and Δθ is strictly inversely proportional to PPR.
map.输入编码器每转单相脉冲数 PPR，工具按 θ_min=360°/(4·PPR)（: Enter encoder pulses per revolution (PPR); the tool computes the minimum resolvable angle as θ_min = 360°/(4·PPR) with quadrature decoding. Higher PPR improves positioning accuracy, which helps with selection and motion-control resolution assessment.
